tagline: For business operators who've hit the ceiling of what they can do alone
metaDescription: Human in Command is a free course, then a method, for business operators who want to direct AI properly without handing over the judgement.

hero.eyebrow: For business operators who've hit the ceiling of what they can do alone
hero.headline: You're the bottleneck. And you already know it.
hero.subheadline: You built this. You run this. Most weeks, you're also the reason it can't grow past you. Human in Command is a free course, then a method, for handing the work to a team of AI agents you actually direct — not another tool to add to the pile, and not a promise that it happens by itself.

introHeading: You already use AI. Probably daily. What you don't have yet is a system.
introQuote: A place it reads from before it writes anything, so you're not re-explaining your business every time and getting something generic back.
methodHeading: Run AI like a small team you actually direct
methodBody: Human in Command teaches a written brief it works from, roles instead of one long chat, a decision log so nothing important only lives in a thread that gets lost, and a weekly rhythm that keeps it all current. Not prompting tricks. An operating system for a business that happens to have AI in it.

methodPillars.title: Business Brain
methodPillars.body: The written brief AI reads before it writes anything: who you are, what you're building, and what only you know.

methodPillars.title: Defined roles
methodPillars.body: Different AI collaborators for different jobs, each with context, boundaries, and a clear task.

methodPillars.title: Decision log
methodPillars.body: Important choices are recorded and accepted by the human, not buried in a chat thread.

methodPillars.title: Weekly rhythm
methodPillars.body: A steady way to check what changed, what matters, what is blocked, and what happens next.

trialBody: Seven segments, about an hour altogether. It teaches the method properly — not a teaser for the paid version, a real course — and by the end you'll have a working first draft of your own Business Brain: the one document that tells any AI who you are, what you're building, and what only you know about your business. Most people finish it at Level 4: equipped, directing one AI properly on real work. If you want to go further, the paid membership is there when you're ready for it, not before.
trialCtaLabel: Watch Segment 1 — Why This Matters Now
proofHeading: Built from the inside of real work
proofBody: Roger Robinson is seventy-four, lives on the Sunshine Coast, and started using AI properly two years ago — later than most of the people who'll tell you how to do it. He works with a small group of AI collaborators daily, disclosed openly rather than hidden, because hiding it would be exactly what this method tells you never to do.

caseStudies.title: Ceylon Adhi Tours
caseStudies.body: A Sri Lankan driver-guide business, built on the same Next.js and Sanity stack, with an AI assistant on the site handling visitor questions and capturing bookings. Still active. Still trading.

caseStudies.title: Sunshine Beauty Therapy
caseStudies.body: Roger's partner Jane's salon, rebuilt with her doing the actual work alongside her own AI setup. Proof the method holds for someone who isn't Roger.

caseStudies.title: Human in Command itself
caseStudies.body: This site, and the course you just watched, built using the exact method it teaches. If it didn't work on its own business, it wouldn't be shown to you.

courseHeading: A first membership intake opens in December 2026

courseModules.title: Small cohort
courseModules.body: Early joiners keep their price for as long as they stay. No manufactured countdown, just a real cap while the review and feedback side is still human-led.

courseModules.title: Annual membership
courseModules.body: The paid layer is for people who want to go beyond the free course: more of the method, more AI collaborators working together, and a steadier build rhythm.

faqs.question: Is this an AI tools course?
faqs.answer: No. Tools matter, but Human in Command is about the operating method: how a human leads AI-assisted work with structure and judgement.

faqs.question: Do I need to be technical?
faqs.answer: No. The course is for non-programmers who want to understand enough to direct the work, ask better questions, and make sound decisions.

faqs.question: Is the free course just a teaser?
faqs.answer: No. It is meant to stand on its own. By the end, you should have a working first draft of your own Business Brain.

faqs.question: When does the membership open?
faqs.answer: The first intake is planned for December 2026. The free course comes first, so people can understand the method before deciding whether the membership is useful.

faqs.question: Why is the course living rather than fixed?
faqs.answer: Because AI tools change quickly. The stable lesson is how to stay in command while the stack evolves.

finalHeading: Human in Command is being built in public, from the inside of real work.
